name: Thabo Cele
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the roar of engines at local karting events in Durban. He excelled in mechanical subjects at school, developing a keen eye for detail and a knack for problem-solving. This led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, where he specialized in quality assurance and testing. Before joining Mercedes-AMG, Thabo gained valuable experience at a smaller racing team, meticulously inspecting components and identifying potential failure points before they impacted performance. His methodical approach, combined with his unwavering loyalty, ensures that every aspect of the car meets the team's stringent standards.

Thabo's dedication extends beyond the technical aspects; he understands the importance of teamwork and communication. He is a strong believer in proactive problem-solving and always seeks to improve processes. His flexible nature allows him to adapt quickly to changing priorities and tight deadlines, making him an invaluable asset to the team. He is particularly skilled at using non-destructive testing methods to identify hidden flaws.

physical.description: Thabo has a lean, athletic build, standing at approximately 5'10".

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and meticulously documents every inspection.
Has a habit of humming softly while concentrating on intricate tasks.
Insists on re-checking measurements even after they've been verified by others.
